WITH customer_first_year AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        toYear(min(DateKey)) AS cohort_year
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
customer_return_flags AS (
    SELECT
        cf.CustomerKey,
        cf.cohort_year,
        max(if(toYear(fos.DateKey) > cf.cohort_year, 1, 0)) AS returned_later
    FROM customer_first_year AS cf
    INNER JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
        ON fos.CustomerKey = cf.CustomerKey
    GROUP BY
        cf.CustomerKey,
        cf.cohort_year
)
SELECT
    cohort_year,
    count() AS cohort_customers,
    sum(returned_later) AS customers_returned_later,
    sum(returned_later) / count() AS return_fraction
FROM customer_return_flags
GROUP BY cohort_year
ORDER BY cohort_year
